text: **dsh-watcher**（DSH 插件，Web/桌面客户端）：将 DSH 会话活动整理为可浏览的 Agent 工作路径，并汇总模型用量。它在会话标题栏提供 Watcher 面板，也可注册 Better Sidebar 页面和设置页；展示轮次、步骤、并行工具执行及状态，支持逐项或按可确认的调用归类查看。面板统计 Token、模型与工具耗时、上下文构成和内置价格表估算费用，并支持手动载入较早历史。适合需要回看任务进展、模型用量或执行记录的 DSH 用户；需要兼容版本的 DeepSeek Harness，无需额外 API Key。

**dsh-watcher** (DSH web plugin) shows session turns, steps, tool outcomes, and timing as a foldable Agent work path. It also summarizes tokens, model usage, context, and estimated costs, with optional older-history loading. Use it to review DSH task progress; no extra API key is required.
想在 DSH 会话里快速看清 Agent 做过哪些步骤和工具调用。
我想回看一轮任务的并行执行、重试和每项工具的结果。
有没有办法把重复的文件修改归在一起，同时还能展开查看原步骤？
DSH 会话里模型用了多少 Token、首响应和工具各花多久？
我想按本轮或整个会话查看模型用量并估算费用。
旧会话记录没有全部载入时，能不能手动补齐历史？
How can I inspect an agent's steps and tool outcomes inside a DSH session?
I want to compare token usage, response timing, and estimated model costs for a session.
Can I load older session pages on demand and follow the agent's latest activity?
工作路径面板按会话轮次呈现阶段、步骤和每次执行的状态与耗时；可切换逐项或归类视图，并在选中记录后查看对应执行细节。
归类视图将可确认属于同一目标或完全相同调用的执行合并计数，同时保留原始项目与步骤，方便比较重试和迭代。
会话统计面板汇总 Token、缓存、模型调用与耗时，并可在本轮、全会话及不同模型汇总之间切换查看。
点击载入全部历史后，Watcher 逐页请求较早会话记录；用户可以取消加载，若页面不再推进或达到上限则停止并说明状态。
设置页允许查看并编辑费用估算价格表；估算依据本地内置模型价格，用户覆盖项保存在浏览器本地存储。

section: 在 DeepSeek Harness 网页版或桌面端安装

text:
dsh-watcher README · 使用 `dsh` 命令行安装：从 [DeepSeek Harness](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@deepseek-ai/dsh) 安装 [`dsh-watcher`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-watcher) 插件：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-watcher
```

更新 `dsh-watcher` 插件：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web update dsh-watcher@latest
```

然后用 `dsh web` 启动 Web 界面。无需构建、无需重启。

这条官方 CLI 命令只写入 `web` profile，不能修改 Desktop App 的 profile；桌面端请使用上面的应用内“添加插件”向导。本发布已提交 `lib/`；普通使用不需要 clone、构建或安装 DSHX。

dsh-watcher README · 使用 `dsh` 命令行安装：需要 DeepSeek Harness **0.2.1-rc.2**（`@deepseek-ai/dsh@0.2.1-rc.2`，`dsh-v0.2.1-rc.2`）。`@deepseek-ai/dsh-*` 的 peer 与 `engines.dsh` 范围是 `>=0.2.1-rc.1 <0.2.2`：接受 **0.2.1-rc.2** 和稳定版 **0.2.1**，拒绝 alpha，也拒绝 **0.2.0-rc.2**。Node `^22.19.0` 或 `>=24`。

DeepSeek Harness Web 的只读插件。点会话标题栏里的眼睛，把 Session 收成一张能折叠的工作路径：这轮走了几步、跑了几次、花了多久；再展开某一步看并行分支、工具结果，或一条默认折着的推理记录。

它不往对话里塞消息，不编隐藏思维链，也不替代官方 Trajectory。

归类只叠能证明相同的调用。两条不同的 bash 不会被捏在一起。模型阶段只显示供应商已经写进 Session 的可见 reasoning；没有记录就写未记录。

dsh-watcher README · 高级安装方式：固定到某个 GitHub 标签：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:aa2246740/dsh-watcher#v0.8.0
```

已经 clone 过的目录也可以（开发/本地测试）：

```sh
git clone https://github.com/aa2246740/dsh-watcher.git
dsh plugin --profile web add ./dsh-watcher
```

同样需要 pnpm，然后重新打开该 Web Host 并刷新页面。

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-watcher
```

官方 CLI 只管理 `web` profile；Desktop App 请使用上面的应用内“添加插件”入口。

dsh-watcher README · 高级安装方式：设置页和会话 HUD 的 Token 总数旁有 **估算费用**（不是「总价值」）。按模型的输入 / 输出 / 缓存桶对照 `pricing/models.yaml` 计价；缺行显示 **未知**，不会当成 $0。部分已知时主数字只显示已标价金额，未标价写在脚注。这是估算，不是账单。默认表含 DeepSeek、MiniMax、OpenAI、Anthropic、Gemini、Grok、GLM、Qwen 主流行，不联网。设置里打开的是当前生效价格表；保存只把改动过的行写入 `localStorage` 键 `dsh-watcher:pricing-override:v1`。欢迎对默认表提 PR。

交互约定在 [DESIGN.md](./DESIGN.md)。MIT。
dsh-watcher README · 本次更新（0.9.1）：- Better Sidebar 里的 Watcher 页改读插件自己的会话上下文。以前那一页拿的是侧栏宿主的 context，读不到 `uiConversation` / `uiSession`，所以会一直停在「正在等待会话记录…」。

dsh-watcher README · 0.9.0：- 对齐官方 DeepSeek Harness **0.2.1-rc.2**（`dsh-v0.2.1-rc.2`，SHA `687f282e8625c6b8d11ff58211a90524be2e4317`）。`@deepseek-ai/dsh-*` 的 peer 与 `engines.dsh` 是 `>=0.2.1-rc.1 <0.2.2`：接受 `0.2.1-rc.2` 和稳定版 `0.2.1`，拒绝 alpha，也拒绝 `0.2.0-rc.2`。
- 图标仍是 `IconChevronRightOutlineRegular`、`IconRefreshOutlineRegular`、`IconCheckOutlineRegular`、`IconCopyOutlineRegular`。这四个名字在 `0.2.1-rc.2` 的 primitives 里还在。带尺寸后缀的旧导出仍然没有。
- 终端卡片补上 `0.2.1` 必填的 `commandLine` 文案（`命令行 N`）。

dsh-watcher README · 0.8.0：- 日图按每次结算的本地日历日记 token，不再把整段会话堆到最后活跃日。旧的 version 1 缓存仍按原来的方式显示，会话重算后变成 version 2。
- 装了 dsh-better-sidebar 时，右侧栏多一个 Watcher 页，内容是工作图。没装时，会话头按钮和设置页不变。侧栏不是依赖。

dsh-watcher README · 0.7.0：- 对齐官方 DeepSeek Harness **0.2.0-rc.2**（`dsh-v0.2.0-rc.2`，SHA `639ed015397290b3745d163aafe02ffee4aa3f84`）。`@deepseek-ai/dsh-*` 的 peer 是 `>=0.2.0-rc.1 <0.2.1`：接受 `0.2.0-rc.2` 和稳定版 `0.2.0`，拒绝 alpha，也拒绝 `0.1.7-rc.2`。
- 图标仍是 `IconChevronRightOutlineRegular`、`IconRefreshOutlineRegular`、`IconCheckOutlineRegular`、`IconCopyOutlineRegular`。这四个名字在 `dsh-v0.2.0-rc.2` 的 primitives 里还在。带尺寸后缀的旧导出仍然没有。

dsh-watcher README · 0.6.1：- 在官方 DeepSeek Harness **0.1.7-rc.2** 上核对通过。`@deepseek-ai/dsh-*` 的 peer 仍是 `>=0.1.7-rc.1 <0.1.8`，安装期接受 `0.1.7-rc.1` 和 `0.1.7-rc.2`，不接受 `0.1.7-alpha.*`。
- 图标仍是 `IconChevronRightOutlineRegular`、`IconRefreshOutlineRegular`、`IconCheckOutlineRegular`、`IconCopyOutlineRegular`。rc.2 同样没有带尺寸后缀的旧导出。

dsh-watcher README · 0.6.0：- 对齐官方 DeepSeek Harness **0.1.7-rc.1**。`@deepseek-ai/dsh-*` 的 peer 改为 `>=0.1.7-rc.1 <0.1.8`，安装期接受 `0.1.7-rc.1`，不接受 `0.1.7-alpha.*`。
- 图标改为 `IconChevronRightOutlineRegular`、`IconRefreshOutlineRegular`、`IconCheckOutlineRegular`、`IconCopyOutlineRegular`。rc.1 删掉了带尺寸后缀的旧导出，没有别名。

dsh-watcher README · 0.5.0：- **面板能拖大。** 右边缘、下边缘和右下角把手都能拖；位置全程不动，最小只能缩回打开时的默认尺寸，不会小到放不下内容。
- **HUD 可折叠成一行。** 范围切换旁多了一个 `▾`，收起只留顶栏统计，选择会被记住。
- **"定位现场"真的到现场。** 现在会选中告警对应的具体失败步骤、直接打开检视器，而不是只滚到轮次标题。
- **连续失败不再刷屏。** 同一条失败链更新同一张卡片，标题带上 `第 N 轮`。

外加一串 0.4.5 的修复：检视器返回不再抢跟随、首次选范围不重复扫会话、投影状态不再存一份自身视图、计时面板文案改为"终端以外的工具"。

历史版本见 [CHANGELOG.md](./CHANGELOG.md)。

dsh-watcher README · 从源码构建：日常安装不用这一步。改 TypeScript 后用 **pnpm** 重建已提交的 `lib/`：

```sh
pnpm install
pnpm test
node scripts/link-harness-dependencies.mjs /path/to/harness
pnpm build

`pnpm build` 需要能解析 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-*` peer 的本机 Harness 检出。装插件不要走这条路径。

冷会话的 Chat 数据尚未到达时，Watcher 显示等待提示，数据到达后再挂载面板。

section: Install on DeepSeek Harness web or desktop

text:
dsh-watcher README · Install with `dsh` cli：Install [`dsh-watcher`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-watcher) plugin from [DeepSeek Harness](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@deepseek-ai/dsh):

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-watcher
```

Or update the `dsh-watcher` plugin:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web update dsh-watcher@latest
```

Then start the web UI with `dsh web`. No build step, no restart.

dsh-watcher README · Install with `dsh` cli：This official CLI command writes only the `web` profile; it cannot modify the Desktop App profile — use the in-app **Add plugin** wizard above for desktop. This release commits `lib/`; normal use needs no clone, build, or DSHX installation.

dsh-watcher README · Install with `dsh` cli：DeepSeek Harness **0.2.1-rc.2** (`@deepseek-ai/dsh@0.2.1-rc.2`, `dsh-v0.2.1-rc.2`). The `@deepseek-ai/dsh-*` peer and `engines.dsh` range is `>=0.2.1-rc.1 <0.2.2`: it accepts **0.2.1-rc.2** and stable **0.2.1**, rejects alphas, and rejects **0.2.0-rc.2**. Node `^22.19.0` or `>=24`.

dsh-watcher README · Install with `dsh` cli：A read-only plugin for DeepSeek Harness Web. Open the eye in the session header. A Session becomes a foldable work path: how many steps ran, how many tools fired, how long it took. Open a step for parallel branches, a tool result, or a reasoning row that stays folded until you ask.

It does not inject messages, invent hidden chain-of-thought, or replace the official Trajectory.

dsh-watcher README · Install with `dsh` cli：Grouped view only stacks what it can prove. Two different bash calls stay apart. The model stage shows only provider-visible reasoning already written into the Session. If nothing was recorded, it says so.

dsh-watcher README · Advanced installs：Pin to a GitHub tag:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:aa2246740/dsh-watcher#v0.8.0
```

From a clone (development/local testing):

```sh
git clone https://github.com/aa2246740/dsh-watcher.git
dsh plugin --profile web add ./dsh-watcher
```

That path also needs pnpm, then reopen that Web Host and reload the page.

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-watcher
```

The public CLI manages `web` only; use the in-app “Add plugin” entry above for the Desktop App.

dsh-watcher README · Advanced installs：The settings summary and session HUD show **Estimated cost** (not “total value”) next to total tokens. Input / output / cache buckets are priced from `pricing/models.yaml`. A missing row is **Unknown**, never $0. A partial estimate keeps the known dollar in the main number and footnotes **Some models unpriced**. It is an estimate, not a bill. The default table covers mainstream DeepSeek, MiniMax, OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Grok, GLM, and Qwen rows and is static (no live fetch). Override it in Watcher settings (`localStorage` key `dsh-watcher:pricing-override:v1`). PRs to the default table are welcome.
dsh-watcher README · Advanced installs：The interaction contract lives in [DESIGN.md](./DESIGN.md). MIT.

dsh-watcher README · What's new in 0.9.1：- The Better Sidebar Watcher page now reads the plugin's own session context. It previously received the sidebar host context, which cannot see `uiConversation` or `uiSession`, so the page stayed on "waiting for the session record…".

dsh-watcher README · 0.9.0：- Targets official DeepSeek Harness **0.2.1-rc.2** (`dsh-v0.2.1-rc.2`, SHA `687f282e8625c6b8d11ff58211a90524be2e4317`). `@deepseek-ai/dsh-*` peers and `engines.dsh` are `>=0.2.1-rc.1 <0.2.2`: the range accepts `0.2.1-rc.2` and stable `0.2.1`, rejects alphas, and rejects `0.2.0-rc.2`.
- Icons stay `IconChevronRightOutlineRegular`, `IconRefreshOutlineRegular`, `IconCheckOutlineRegular`, and `IconCopyOutlineRegular`. Those four names are still exported by primitives at `0.2.1-rc.2`. The size-suffixed names are still absent.
- Terminal card labels add the required `commandLine` copy (`命令行 N`) introduced in `0.2.1`.

dsh-watcher README · 0.8.0：- The daily chart books each token settlement on the local calendar day. A session total is no longer piled onto the last active day. Version 1 caches keep the old display until that session is refolded into version 2.
- With dsh-better-sidebar installed, the right sidebar gains a Watcher page for the work picture. Without it, the header button and the settings section stay as they are. The sidebar package is not a dependency.

dsh-watcher README · 0.7.0：- Targets official DeepSeek Harness **0.2.0-rc.2** (`dsh-v0.2.0-rc.2`, SHA `639ed015397290b3745d163aafe02ffee4aa3f84`). `@deepseek-ai/dsh-*` peers are `>=0.2.0-rc.1 <0.2.1`: the range accepts `0.2.0-rc.2` and stable `0.2.0`, rejects alphas, and rejects `0.1.7-rc.2`.
- Icons stay `IconChevronRightOutlineRegular`, `IconRefreshOutlineRegular`, `IconCheckOutlineRegular`, and `IconCopyOutlineRegular`. Those four names are still exported by primitives at `dsh-v0.2.0-rc.2`. The size-suffixed names are still absent.

dsh-watcher README · 0.6.1：- Checked on official DeepSeek Harness **0.1.7-rc.2**. `@deepseek-ai/dsh-*` peers stay `>=0.1.7-rc.1 <0.1.8`, so install accepts `0.1.7-rc.1` and `0.1.7-rc.2` and rejects `0.1.7-alpha.*`.
- Icons stay `IconChevronRightOutlineRegular`, `IconRefreshOutlineRegular`, `IconCheckOutlineRegular`, and `IconCopyOutlineRegular`. rc.2 still does not export the size-suffixed names.

dsh-watcher README · 0.6.0：- Targets official DeepSeek Harness **0.1.7-rc.1**. `@deepseek-ai/dsh-*` peers are `>=0.1.7-rc.1 <0.1.8`, so install accepts `0.1.7-rc.1` and rejects `0.1.7-alpha.*`.
- Icons are `IconChevronRightOutlineRegular`, `IconRefreshOutlineRegular`, `IconCheckOutlineRegular`, and `IconCopyOutlineRegular`. rc.1 removed the size-suffixed exports and ships no aliases.

dsh-watcher README · 0.5.0：- **The panel resizes.** Drag the right edge, the bottom edge, or the corner grip; the frame stays put while it grows, and it can never shrink below the size it opened at.
- **The HUD folds to one line.** A `▾` next to the scope switch collapses the timing panel to just the top bar, and the choice is remembered.
- **"定位现场" lands on the actual failure.** It now selects the exact failing step and opens the inspector on it instead of scrolling to a bare turn header.
- **Repeated failures no longer stack.** One failure chain updates one card, and the title names its turn (`第 N 轮`).

dsh-watcher README · 0.5.0：Plus the 0.4.5 fixes: the inspector back control no longer re-arms follow, the first range pick no longer rescans sessions, the projection state no longer stores a copy of its own view, and the timing panel's non-terminal slice is labelled correctly.

Older releases: [CHANGELOG.md](./CHANGELOG.md).

dsh-watcher README · Build from source：Skip this for a normal install. Rebuild the committed `lib/` with **pnpm** after TypeScript changes:

```sh
pnpm install
pnpm test
node scripts/link-harness-dependencies.mjs /path/to/harness
pnpm build

`pnpm build` needs a local Harness checkout that can resolve the `@deepseek-ai/dsh-*` peers. Do not use this path to install the plugin.

Watcher waits for the Chat projection on cold sessions before mounting its panel.
